text:
deploy-bot: Deploy starting: service=worker-api version=v2.13.0 -> prod. Canary 10% for 20m. /deploy 1823456789

maria: starting monitoring window. watching gen-route and emb-route p95 + errors

liam: noted. I'll watch 5xx, queue depth, and backpressure signals

mon-bot: SLO snapshot @22:02 UTC: gen-route p95 = 290ms (+16% vs baseline 250ms). emb-route 5xx = 0.12% (threshold 0.1%). infra CPU steady.

ashley: canary at 10% is up. checking regional split now — nothing obvious in infra metrics

jay: eu-west shows a small 5xx blip at 22:03 UTC, spikes to 0.4% for ~30s then tapering. correlates with a few cache misses in traces

maria: hmm. do we want to pause the ramp or shrink canary? what are our rollback gates for this deploy?

liam: gate summary: pause/rollback if 5xx > 0.3% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 20% increase sustained 5m OR error-budget burn >5% in 10m. also any region-specific >0.5% immediate hold.

maria: rolling back would pin traffic to v2.12.9 (last stable). prefer pause and triage first if possible

ashley: digging into traces — consistent pattern: KV cache miss on canary nodes -> sync DB fallback -> tail latency. looks like cache warmup issue

mon-bot: sample traces: failure stack: cache.lookup -> miss -> db.sync_read (latency +150ms) -> downstream timeout if >1.2s

jay: short-term mitigation: reduce canary to 5% and enable cache-prefill on canary pods, or pause entirely and route back to stable

maria: decision: pause ramp. set canary to 0% and move traffic back to stable for safety. if metrics recover in 10m we attempt a smaller 5% ramp. :exclamation:

deploy-bot: Canary pause executed by @maria. Traffic moved back to v2.12.9. Auto-rollback disabled (manual only).

ashley: deploying cache-prefill change to canary set (small restart on 2/4 nodes), will report when done

mon-bot: 22:07 snapshot: emb-route 5xx -> 0.08%, gen-route p95 -> 260ms (improving). traces show fewer fallback DB hits

liam: good trend. if p95 < 250ms in 10m we can consider resuming partial canary. otherwise consider full rollback and pin

maria: updating release notes: "Canary paused due to cache-miss induced tail latencies and 5xx spike; mitigation applied (cache-prefill). Resuming only after verification."

jay: doc link for runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cache-prefill-note — includes steps for prefill + detection thresholds

ashley: cache-prefill completed on canary nodes, restarting proxies now (no downtime expected)

mon-bot: 22:12 update: gen-route p95 = 245ms, emb-route 5xx = 0.04%. sample traces show fallback path reduced. :thumbsup:

maria: resuming canary at 5% after validation. monitoring window extended to 15m. if any gate trips we will pause and escalate

liam: I'll keep alerts unmuted for the region but suppress noise for transient <30s spikes. manual escalate if >0.2% sustained

jay: noted. i'll prepare a quick checklist for the oncall in case we need to pin traffic or trigger rollback

maria: closing loop: no full rollback required. follow-ups: add cache-prefill step to deploy job (automate) and add a small synthetic to detect cold-cache regressions

ashley: creating PR for prefill step + updating deploy docs, will link in the ticket

deploy-bot: Deploy update: canary resumed at 5%. Timeline: started 22:00 UTC, paused 22:05 UTC, mitigation applied 22:08 UTC, resumed 22:13 UTC. Monitoring continues.
